en.name: Honorius IV
en.summary: An elderly, severely arthritic Roman pope of the Savelli family who governed a Papal States still reeling from the Sicilian Vespers revolt.
en.body: Honorius IV, so afflicted by arthritis that he reportedly needed a mechanical device to help him raise his hands during Mass, nonetheless worked energetically to stabilize the Papal States and Angevin interests following the loss of Sicily to Aragon in the aftermath of the Vespers uprising. He also promoted the study of Oriental languages at European universities to aid missionary efforts.
